strategies.outdated: This analysis was written prior to Miraidon's ban. As such, the information provided is out of date and does not accurately reflect the current metagame. Bear with us while we rework our analyses!
strategies.overview: Arceus-Fairy is a defensive behemoth that cements itself a place in Ubers as one of the best checks to Koraidon. An immunity to Dragon and a resistance to Low Kick give Arceus-Fairy ample opportunities to switch in while also forcing Koraidon to use Flare Blitz more often and decrease its longevity as a result. Furthermore, Arceus-Fairy's bulk and resistances make it a useful soft check to Pokemon such as Arceus, Giratina-O, Kyurem-B, Zekrom, Chien-Pao, Rayquaza, and even Miraidon and Flutter Mane. Good neutral coverage with Fairy-type Judgment allows Arceus-Fairy to take full advantage of its ample support movepool featuring Thunder Wave, Will-O-Wisp, Stealth Rock, and Taunt. Outside of being a bit passive against Necrozma-DM, Ho-Oh, and Zacian-C and having to play around opposing Terastallization carefully, Arceus-Fairy has little to no flaws and should be strongly considered for any balance team.
strategies.comments:
Other Options

Earth Power and Power Gem are coverage options for a fully dedicated Calm Mind set. The problem is that Arceus-Fairy always loses to either Necrozma-DM or Ho-Oh, so while these coverage options are viable, they require dedicated team support. Of the two, Earth Power is more plausible, as Ho-Oh may be crippled by Knock Off support. Losing access to status or Stealth Rock also leaves Arceus-Fairy more passive in general.

Checks and Counters

Fairy-Resistant Tanks: Necrozma-DM, Ho-Oh, and Zacian-C take little damage from Judgment and can use Arceus-Fairy as an opportunity to set up, although none of them like taking Thunder Wave.

Tera Fire Users: Arceus-Fairy cannot burn common physical attackers like Koraidon and Necrozma-DM after they have used Tera Fire, which also greatly weakens the power of Judgment. Koraidon can notably guarantee the OHKO on Arceus-Fairy at +2 with Tera Fire Flare Blitz, necessitating Arceus-Fairy to use Tera Water itself. These Pokemon are still vulnerable to Thunder Wave, but they may still be able to sweep with enough boosts.

Chip Damage: Arceus-Fairy is vulnerable to all forms of status and entry hazard damage, which force it to use Recover more often and lose momentum.

Calm Mind: Calm Mind users like Arceus-Ground, Kyogre, and Arceus-Grass take little from Judgment and can use Calm Mind relatively freely as a result.

movesets.name: Defensive Wall
movesets.description:
This set gives Arceus-Fairy its best chance at taking on Koraidon. Thunder Wave is extremely useful for crippling all of Arceus-Fairy's most common switch-ins in Necrozma-DM, Ho-Oh, and Zacian-C. It is also a safe move to use against Koraidon should you expect it to use Tera Fire and is especially useful because Arceus-Fairy discourages all Ground- and Electric-types bar Clodsire from switching in. Will-O-Wisp more directly cripples physical attackers like Koraidon and Necrozma-DM, although it cannot hit Ho-Oh and Tera Fire users. The third moveslot is fairly flexible; Stealth Rock is a good option, as it frees up moveslots for Arceus-Fairy's teammates. Taunt prevents Clodsire and specially defensive Gliscor from being able to use Spikes and Toxic. Dragon Tail can be a good way to rack up entry hazard damage and can phaze setup sweepers that may not mind being hit with status, and it is highly recommended when running Will-O-Wisp. Calm Mind turns Arceus-Fairy into a dangerous setup sweeper, albeit one that requires significant team support to handle Necrozma-DM and especially Ho-Oh. It is a good option on teams that already have plentiful ways to spread status. Tera Water is mandatory in case Arceus-Fairy needs to take a boosted Flare Blitz from Koraidon, and it can be useful in a pinch against Necrozma-DM and Zacian-C. Tera Water in combination with Calm Mind can more easily clean up weakened teams, as Necrozma-DM won't have a coverage option to hit Arceus-Fairy. The EVs allow Arceus-Fairy to outspeed maximum Speed neutral-natured base 90 Pokemon such as Kyogre, with the rest being dumped into physical bulk.

While Arceus-Fairy is a great wall, it's unable to take on notable physical attackers like Necrozma-DM and Zacian-C without Terastallizing. As a result, defensive Necrozma-DM is a fantastic partner, and the two together reasonably cover nearly all physical threats in the tier. Ting-Lu and Clodsire can take on Miraidon and appreciate Arceus-Fairy's Dragon immunity that allows it to pivot into Draco Meteor, making them fantastic teammates. Defensive Ho-Oh, Gliscor, and Eternatus can handle offensive Ho-Oh without much fear of Sacred Fire burns, with Eternatus having the added benefit of checking Kyogre and absorbing Toxic Spikes. Strong but relatively slow wallbreakers such as Kyogre, Swords Dance Necrozma-DM, and offensive Ho-Oh like the paralysis support that Arceus-Fairy can provide. Kyogre notably helps with the Koraidon matchup, as it can pivot into Flare Blitz and bring rain that negates Koraidon's ability, making it a great partner. Giratina-O can handle Arceus-Ground and provide much-appreciated Defog support.

movesets.name: Iron Defense + Calm Mind
movesets.description:
Leveraging its great bulk and typing, Arceus-Fairy can utilize Iron Defense and Calm Mind to become an excellent late-game wincon and act as a defensive anchor on bulkier teams and defensive cores to take on the dangerous Koraidon. Iron Defense allows it to set up in front of threats such as Koraidon and physical Arceus formes lacking Taunt, while Calm Mind helps Arceus-Fairy to OHKO or 2HKO foes with Judgment and become nigh-unstoppable when paired with Defense boosts. Tera Poison stops Eternatus from crippling Arceus-Fairy with Toxic, removes its weakness to Zacian-C's Behemoth Blade, gives it a resistance to offensive Eternatus's Sludge Bomb, and lets it act as a Toxic Spikes absorber later on in the game if Arceus-Fairy's partner Eternatus has been knocked out. Tera Water allows Arceus-Fairy to resist Koraidon's Flare Blitz, Kyogre's Water Spout and Origin Pulse, Zacian-C's Behemoth Blade, and Necrozma-DM's Sunsteel Strike. However, it makes Arceus-Fairy weak to Zacian-C's Wild Charge and Kyogre's Thunder. The Speed EVs allow Arceus-Fairy to outpace maximum investment base 90 Speed Pokemon, such as Kyogre, Zekrom, and Groudon, while the rest are dumped into physical bulk.

Iron Defense + Calm Mind Arceus-Fairy is incredibly potent in late-game scenarios where it is the last Pokemon standing, which prevents it from being phazed by Whirlwind or Dragon Tail if it has Terastallized. However, due to the limited PP of Recover, Arceus-Fairy should refrain from taking too much damage early on to preserve its ability for a late-game sweep. Eternatus can absorb Toxic Spikes for Arceus-Fairy in late-game scenarios, letting it set up more easily. Eternatus can also switch into Ho-Oh, which frequently forces Arceus-Fairy to switch out, and cripple it with Toxic. Kyogre can take on Koraidon for Arceus-Fairy much more comfortably by deactivating Orichalcum Pulse and weakening Flare Blitz with Drizzle. Landorus-T could provide entry hazard support with Stealth Rock, since this Arceus-Fairy set is not running it, while also serving as a temporary check to the dangerous Zacian-C. Defensive Ho-Oh can help check Steel-types such as Zacian-C and Necrozma-DM, which could pressure Arceus-Fairy, especially with hazards up. Ho-Oh can check opposing special Arceus formes and Eternatus, though Ho-Oh could also run offensive sets, and Arceus-Fairy and Kyogre could take on the task of checking Koraidon instead. As Arceus-Fairy is vulnerable to entry hazards, teammates that could help with hazard control, such as Giratina-O and Terapagos, should also be considered.

strategies.overview: Arceus-Fairy is one of the best walls in AG and one of the very few defensive Pokemon that is able to reliably check Koraidon thanks to an immunity to Dragon-type moves letting it block Scale Shot and a resistance to Low Kick and Close Combat. This forces Koraidon to use Flare Blitz to KO Arceus-Fairy, which derails its longevity. Additionally, Arceus-Fairy's good bulk allows it to soft check Pokemon such as Extreme Killer Arceus, Ho-Oh, and Giratina-O. Arceus-Fairy can sometimes be a bit passive versus Steel-types such as Necrozma-DM and Zacian-C; although, both are unable to switch in on Arceus-Fairy because it likes to carry Will-O-Wisp to cripple them. Furthermore, Eternatus is able to take on Arceus-Fairy and use Toxic on it. If not, then it can set up Toxic Spikes without taking any significant damage. Apart from these weaknesses, Arceus-Fairy is almost flawless and should always be considered on balance and bulky offense teams.
strategies.comments:
Other Options

Arceus-Fairy can run Stealth Rock in conjunction with Ting-Lu's Spikes. Although, this means that Arceus-Fairy has to drop either a status-inducing move or Power Gem. On more offense-oriented teams, Arceus-Fairy can opt to run Taunt paired with Thunder Wave, paralyzing foes and stopping Ho-Oh, bulky Arceus formes, and Eternatus from using Recover.

Checks and Counters

Steel-types: Steel-types such as Zacian-C and Necrozma-DM are able to brute force their way through Arceus-Fairy thanks to their powerful Steel moves. Although, both must be wary of Arceus-Fairy Terastallizing into a Water-type and burning them with Will-O-Wisp.

Kyogre: Kyogre is a great lead and likes to carry Thunder Wave to cripple Arceus-Fairy. Furthermore, Kyogre's Drizzle-boosted Origin Pulse 2HKOes Arceus-Fairy.

Tera Fire Users: Setup users such as Extreme Killer Arceus, Dragon Dance Arceus-Ground, Koraidon, and Calyrex-I like to run Tera Fire to block Arceus-Fairy's Will-O-Wisp. Although, Thunder Wave can cripple them.

Eternatus: Eternatus can poison Arceus-Fairy without taking any significant damage in return. Furthermore, it is able to set up Toxic Spikes, which derails Arceus-Fairy's longevity.

Calyrex-S: Calyrex-S is able to take on a low HP Arceus-Fairy with Astral Barrage or 2HKO it with Tera Ghost or Choice Specs. Although, Calyrex-S must be wary of Thunder Wave when switching in on Arceus-Fairy.

Taunt Users: Although mostly seen on offensive teams, Taunt users such as Extreme Killer Arceus and Dragon Dance Arceus-Ground can prevent Arceus-Fairy from using Will-O-Wisp to burn them.

movesets.name: Defensive
movesets.description:
This set allows Arceus-Fairy to reliably take on Koraidon. Judgment hits Dark- and Dragon-types like Ting-Lu, Koraidon, and Miraidon super effectively, deterring Miraidon from switching in freely. It also acts as good neutral coverage that deals good damage to Calyrex-S, Arceus formes, Kyogre, and Hatterene. Power Gem gives Arceus-Fairy a reliable way of hitting Ho-Oh, having a chance at 2HKOing it. Will-O-Wisp prevents setup sweepers such as Zacian-C, Necrozma-DM, Extreme Killer Arceus, and Calyrex-I from safely switching in on Arceus-Fairy. Although, Will-O-Wisp is unable to burn Ho-Oh and Tera Fire users such as Calyrex-I, Extreme Killer Arceus, Arceus-Ground, Koraidon, and Necrozma-DM. Thunder Wave on the other hand cripples the likes of Ho-Oh, Necrozma-DM, Zacian-C, Eternatus, and bulky Arceus formes, as all of them commonly switch in on Arceus-Fairy. Arceus-Fairy can opt for a dual status set to punish not only physical attackers with Will-O-Wisp but also Calyrex-S, Kyogre, and Eternatus on a switch in with Thunder Wave. Although, running this set means that Arceus-Fairy cannot do reliable damage to Ho-Oh because it is not carrying Power Gem. Tera Water allows Arceus-Fairy to check Zacian-C and Koraidon in a pinch and burn both with Will-O-Wisp. A drawback of Tera Water is that it makes Arceus-Fairy weak to Miraidon's Electro Drift, Zacian-C's Wild Charge, and Calyrex-S's Grass Knot. Additionally, Tera Water makes Arceus-Fairy no longer immune to Dragon-type moves and removes its resistance to Koraidon's Low Kick. Tera Poison on the other hand grants Arceus-Fairy an immunity to poison, lets it absorb Toxic Spikes, and makes it resist opposing Arceus-Fairy's Judgment. A major downside of both the aforementioned Tera types is that with them Arceus-Fairy is unable to block Koraidon's Scale Shot, which can cause a snowball into a quick sweep.

Arceus-Fairy is a staple on balance and bulky offense teams. Despite Arceus-Fairy being an almost flawless wall, it is still unable to check physical attackers such as Zacian-C and Necrozma-DM without Terastallization. Ho-Oh makes a great teammate for Arceus-Fairy, as it is able to check both because of Sacred Fire having a 50% burn chance. Also, thanks to Koraidon's omnipresent Sun, Ho-Oh's Sacred Fire can 2HKO Necrozma-DM and OHKO Zacian-C. Calyrex-S and Miraidon are able to do great amounts of damage to Arceus-Fairy; to effectively deal with them, Arceus-Fairy greatly appreciates Ting-Lu as a teammate, which can pivot in on both foes. Ting-Lu can also soft check Necrozma-DM and set up Spikes, keeping opposing sweepers on a timer. Defensive Ho-Oh and Eternatus are able to keep up with offensive Ho-Oh, with Eternatus threatening to poison it. Furthermore, Eternatus can check Kyogre and both absorb and set up Toxic Spikes whenever required. Due to being tasked to deal with so many physical attackers, Arceus-Fairy can get overwhelmed. It appreciates Choice Scarf users such as Koraidon and Calyrex-S, which can revenge kill these attackers with their powerful STAB moves. Koraidon may run Tera Steel in conjunction with Substitute and Iron Head to get the better of Arceus-Fairy, forcing it to Terastallize in most interactions. To beat Tera Steel Koraidon, Arceus-Fairy once again likes Ting-Lu as its teammate, since it is able to phaze Koraidon with Whirlwind. Necozma-DM can also beat this Koraidon set one-on-one thanks to its bulk and access to Dragon Dance. Although, both Necrozma-DM and Ting-Lu must be careful of Low Kick, which Tera Steel Koraidon can sometimes run over Substitute. Furthermore, Choice Scarf Koraidon and Calyrex-S can revenge kill this foe too.

movesets.name: Offensive Calm Mind
movesets.description:
Calm Mind Arceus-Fairy is a fantastic wallbreaker and sweeper on bulky offense and offense teams that takes advantage of the Fairy-type's amazing offensive prowess and good defensive capabilities in AG to set up against a vast majority of the metagame. Judgment hits Dragon- and Dark-types like Koraidon, Miraidon, and Ting-Lu super effectively, notably OHKOing the former two and 2HKOing Calyrex-S without any boosts. At +1, it 2HKOes neutral targets like bulky Arceus formes and Kyogre and deals significant damage to Eternatus. Power Gem allows Arceus-Fairy to break past Fire-types like Ho-Oh, Tera Fire Arceus, and Skeledirge. Tera Poison flips the matchup on Eternatus, allowing Arceus-Fairy to set up Calm Mind freely and absorb Toxic Spikes. However, it comes with the drawback of making Arceus-Fairy weak to Ting-Lu's Earthquake, though the latter needs to Terastallize into a Steel- or Poison-type to avoid taking heavy damage from boosted Judgment. Tera Poison also leaves Arceus-Fairy weak to Calyrex-S's Psychic and Psyshock, with the latter inflicting heavy damage to even a boosted Arceus-Fairy. Additionally, it makes Arceus-Fairy vulnerable to Koraidon's Scale Shot, which can revenge kill a weakened Arceus-Fairy while threatening a sweep. A Timid nature is preferred for outspeeding Modest Miraidon and max Speed Arceus formes without a Speed boosting nature, though Modest is still a viable alternative for the increased damage output, notably 2HKOing Eternatus and having a chance to OHKO Ho-Oh, both at +1.

Calm Mind Arceus-Fairy serves as an excellent addition to teams looking for a potent, self-sufficient wallbreaker and setup sweeper that applies tremendous pressure on the opponent's defensive backbone, clearing a path for teammates like Calyrex-S, Choice Scarf Koraidon, and Swords Dance Arceus to clean up late-game. Arceus-Fairy takes advantage of passive switch-ins like Ho-Oh, Ting-Lu, Landorus-T, and bulky Arceus formes to set up Calm Mind and punch holes through opposing teams. It finds ample setup opportunities to sweep against most teams; however, the lack of coverage for Steel-types, particularly Necrozma-DM and Zacian-C, renders it ineffective against them. Both are capable of surviving boosted Judgment and take advantage of Arceus-Fairy to set up Dragon Dance and Swords Dance, respectively. Necrozma-DM, backed by recovery from Moonlight, has no issues against Arceus-Fairy long-term. Due to this set not having any defensive investment, it is easily overwhelmed by strong attackers such as Calyrex-S, Swords Dance Arceus, Kyogre, and Dragon Dance Arceus-Ground. Arceus-Fairy also takes massive damage from Koraidon and Miraidon, but neither likes to switch in directly due to fearing an OHKO from Judgment. Hence, it appreciates teammates such as Ting-Lu, Arceus-Water, Eternatus, and Landorus-T. Ting-Lu provides entry hazard support and switches in on strong attacks such as Calyrex-S's Astral Barrage and Miraidon's Electro Drift, which threaten Arceus-Fairy out. Arceus-Water and Landorus-T help cover a myriad of physical attackers such as Koraidon, Swords Dance Arceus, Dragon Dance Arceus-Ground, Zacian-C, and Necrozma-DM. Landorus-T also helps to bring in Arceus-Fairy via U-turn, thereby increasing setup chances. As Arceus-Fairy is vulnerable to status, especially Thunder Wave, Eternatus is a good partner that takes on Ho-Oh's Sacred Fire and switches in on Kyogre's rain-boosted Water Spout and Origin Pulse as well as Thunder Wave. It also cripples defensive cores by spreading poison with Toxic Spikes, making it easier for Arceus-Fairy to clean up weakened teams. Calyrex-S and Choice Scarf Koraidon are great revenge killers, threatening both Necrozma-DM and Zacian-C. Special walls such as Clodsire, Whirlwind Tera Grass Ho-Oh, and Calm Mind Blissey are capable of stopping Arceus-Fairy from sweeping by phazing it or shrugging off boosted hits. Thus, partners such as Choice Specs Calyrex-S, Koraidon, offensive Ho-Oh, and Swords Dance Arceus that can break the aforementioned walls make for great teammates. Koraidon and Miraidon provide opportunities for Arceus-Fairy to set up through pivoting with U-turn against common switch-ins such as defensive Arceus formes, Ho-Oh, and Ting-Lu.

strategies.outdated: This analysis was written before BH had a major shakeup. As such, the set(s) and comments may not be up-to-date.
strategies.overview: Arceus-Fairy is a great, flexible, defensive option for most teams thanks to its typing, good bulk that allows it to serve a role as either a Fur Coat or an Ice Scales Pokemon, and high Speed that eclipses most physical attackers for the Fur Coat set. Its bulk also makes it a solid choice for a bulky Take Heart sweeper, with Thunder Cage + Strength Sap allowing it to beat most Imposter users one-on-one. A mixed set with Pixilate allows Arceus-Fairy to scare potential checks and counters with a powerful Extreme Speed. Arceus-Fairy's main flaw is arguably its dependence on Strength Sap for healing, which means Magic Guard Blissey and Chansey are perfect counters, since they have the perfect kits to freely switch into Arceus-Fairy and stall it out; Arceus-Fairy can't reliably use Recover instead, as doing so completely forfeits its advantage against Impostor users. Additionally, Fur Coat Arceus-Fairy can struggle against common Steel-type coverage from Choice Band users like Mega Garchomp, while Ice Scales variants are vulnerable to Eternatus and super effective coverage like Noxious Torque Ash-Greninja and Gigaton Hammer Mega Sceptile.
strategies.comments:
Other Options

Heavy-Duty Boots serves as a good option for Arceus-Fairy in general, as preventing entry hazard damage can end up being important in the long run. Covert Cloak is also a viable option, preventing a lot of chip damage from Salt Cure. Arceus-Fairy can run a more support-oriented moveset with moves such as Spikes, but this makes it quite challenging to Impostor-proof.

Checks and Counters

Blissey and Chansey: Their immense bulk and Magic Guard render Take Heart Arceus-Fairy almost helpless against them, and their tiny Attack means Arceus-Fairy heals for basically nothing with Strength Sap.

Ice Scales: Other Ice Scales users, such as various Arceus forms, Meloetta, and Mega Audino, can check Take Heart Arceus-Fairy, though they should be wary of Thunder Cage's residual damage.

Steel-types: Strong Steel-type wallbreakers such as Mega Lucario greatly threaten Arceus-Fairy. Defensively, Pokemon like Solgaleo and Arceus-Steel can check all variants of Arceus-Fairy.

Salt Cure: Unless Covert Cloak is used, Salt Cure puts Take Heart Arceus-Fairy on a timer, making it more difficult to set up, as well as making it so Arceus-Fairy is unable to Impostor-proof itself.

Eternatus: Eternatus can pressure unboosted Arceus-Fairy out with Poison-type moves. Unaware Eternatus can switch in on any Arceus-Fairy and use it as setup fodder.

movesets.name: Take Heart
movesets.description:
Take Heart provides boosting while denying poison from Mortal Spin, which would otherwise force it out. The Fairy-type move of choice can vary: Moonblast is the 2nd strongest Fairy move of the bunch, has higher PP, and has a decent Special Attack drop, while Revelation Dance is effective against Normalize. Leftovers allows Arceus-Fairy to not have its healing cut off by Pokemon with low attack, as well as giving it increased longevity.

Arceus-Fairy is typically splashed onto bulkier teams as a wall against threats like Mega Garchomp, Mega Sceptile, and Ash-Greninja, in addition to compressing a late-game win condition at the same time. Arceus-Fairy's solid typing and bulk mean it can serve as a good Imposter-proof to Pokemon like these. Arceus-Fairy does falter to fast Pokemon that can easily slot Steel or Poison-type coverage, like Koraidon for Fur Coat sets, and Sheer Force Ash-Greninja for Ice Scales sets, so defensive Pokemon that can stonewall them like RegenVest Dialga-O, Mega Swampert, and Zamazenta can assist with that, and, in Mega Swampert's case, provides a very valuable check to the threatening Mega Lucario. Arceus-Fairy is both stonewalled and has its healing denied by Blissey and Chansey, so a teammate with Psystrike or a similar move that can pressure them out, like Mega Gardevoir or High Jump Kick Mega Sceptile, is highly recommended.

movesets.name: Calm Mind
movesets.description:
Calm Mind Arceus-Fairy has a very well rounded set of credentials, sporting reliable bulk, a sound typing both offensively and defensively, good power after Calm Mind boosts, and a solid Speed tier, allowing it to function as a reliable bulky wincon. Calm Mind grants Arceus-Fairy extra power and shores up its special bulk, and Recover lets it stay healthy and get more boosts off. Judgment is a strong STAB move that can score 2HKOs on common special walls such as Great Tusk, Ting-Lu, and Mandibuzz, while Earth Power allows Arceus-Fairy to hit Steel-types such as Excadrill, Heatran, and Zacian-C. The Speed EVs allow Arceus-Fairy to outspeed Ogerpon-W and unboosted Iron Moth and eventually beat them. Tera Ground gives Earth Power a little more power to OHKO Zacian-C at +1 after Stealth Rock and allows it to 2HKO Eternatus and physically defensive Clodsire, with the additional benefit of allowing Arceus-Fairy to resist Poison-type moves from the likes of Sneasler, Iron Moth, and Eternatus that would otherwise KO it.

Arceus-Fairy has an amazing set of stats to donate, allowing it to build a very wide variety of teams around itself, but Calm Mind Arceus-Fairy works best on balance and bulky offense structures that can wear down the opposing team to prepare for Arceus-Fairy to finish them off. A multitude of Pokemon love to receive Arceus-Fairy's great HP stat, including but not limited to: Rotom-W, Pecharunt, and Landorus-T. Arceus-Fairy's high defensive stats also lend themselves to bulky pivots such as the aforementioned three Pokemon, which support Arceus-Fairy by getting it in safely. Hisuian Samurott and Meowscarada are great choices to receive Arceus-Fairy's Attack stat, as they provide Spikes, pivoting, and Knock Off support. Entry hazard setters such as the aforementioned Hisuian Samurott, Great Tusk, and Landorus-T help wear down specially defensive Pokemon so that Arceus-Fairy has a better shot at 2HKOing them later. Arceus-Fairy struggles to break bulky Pokemon such as Skarmory, Dondozo, and Ho-Oh, so it appreciates Pokemon that beat these walls, such as Ogerpon-W and Zapdos. Other special attackers like Hisuian Electrode and Hoopa-U can force in mutual checks such as Clodsire, Galarian Slowking, and specially defensive Excadrill and chip them so that Arceus-Fairy can overpower them with Calm Mind boosts further down the line, with Hisuian Electrode also being able to pivot with Volt Switch.

movesets.name: Defensive
movesets.description:
• Arceus-Fairy can perform a wide variety of defensive roles thanks to its Fairy typing, solid stats, wide movepool, and a nice Speed tier. It is able to switch into multiple top threats of the metagame such as Mega Salamence, Yveltal, Zygarde, Arceus-Dark, and Marshadow and cripple them with various options or set Stealth Rock as they're forced out, enabling it to fit in balance and defensive team structures.
  • Taunt allows Arceus-Fairy to prevent setup, recovery, entry hazards, hazard control via Defog, and crippling status moves such as Glare and Toxic from Pokemon such as Primal Groudon, Zygarde, Ho-Oh, and Giratina-O. This move isn't recommended on specially defensive variants, as it's relatively easy for foes, such as some variants of the Pokemon listed above, to outspeed Arceus-Fairy, thus rendering most of Taunt's purposes niche.
  • Toxic complements Judgment to cripple foes that can easily switch into it, including Ho-Oh, Arceus-Ground, and Primal Groudon, Will-O-Wisp alternatively allows Arceus-Fairy to cripple the Poison- and Steel-types it lures in, such as Zacian-C, Necrozma-DM, and Eternatus, while also creating an easier matchup against multiple physical attackers such as Terastallized Zygarde and Marshadow.
  • Stealth Rock forces progress for Arceus-Fairy's team, as it forces out relevant hazard removers such as Yveltal and Giratina-O. With Stealth Rock active, Arceus-Fairy has high odds to OHKO Ultra Necrozma and Palkia-O with Judgment.
  • Given Arceus-Fairy can often stay in on common hazard setters such as Primal Groudon and opposing support Arceus formes, if Arceus-Fairy has Toxic, it can act as a viable Defogger.
  • Refresh increases Arceus-Fairy's longevity and consistency at checking foes, reducing the potential risk of switching into Glare from Zygarde and Toxic from Ho-Oh, Arceus-Dark, and Primal Groudon. It also renders special sets of Giratina-O unable to do much in return, as Hex does poor damage without a status condition.
  • The given EV spread with a Bold nature allows Arceus-Fairy to outspeed Primal Groudon to better facilitate using Taunt and Recover, with the rest of the EVs being placed in Defense to render it as physically bulky as possible, letting it avoid a 2HKO from Choice Band Marshadow's Poltergeist.
  • Alternatively, a specially defensive spread of 248 HP / 136 Def / 108 SpD / 16 Spe with a Calm nature lets Arceus-Fairy avoid a 2HKO from Palkia-O's Hydro Pump and Primal Groudon's Overheat and a 2HKO from Choice Band Marshadow's Spectral Thief after Stealth Rock, and it can outspeed uninvested Primal Groudon. Additionally it also allows Arceus-Fairy to check Mega Mewtwo Y, and after Terastallizing to the Poison-type, Eternatus. This spread, however, has the flaws of being easier to overwhelm by physical attackers and vulnerability to Taunt from Pokemon such as other defensive Arceus formes and Terastallized Yveltal.
  • Tera Water lets Arceus-Fairy more comfortably wall foes such as Primal Groudon, Zacian-C and Necrozma-DM, in turn allowing Arceus-Fairy to cripple them with a status condition. Arceus-Fairy also gains a resistance to Palkia-O's Hydro Pump, granting it the momentum to greatly damage it even if it uses its physically defensive spread.
  • Tera Poison increases Arceus-Fairy's longevity by giving it an immunity to Toxic and removing its weaknesses to Steel- and Poison-type moves, letting it switch into Zacian-C, Eternatus without Meteor Beam, Giratina-O, Arceus-Dark, and opposing Arceus-Fairy.
  • Arceus-Fairy is a Pokemon that does not Terastallize often, as its innate typing already provides the option to act as a wall for a good portion of the metagame, and its allies often make better use of it.
  • Arceus-Fairy's Judgment is often easy to switch into early- to mid-game, so most of the time utility moves are used instead for consistency and to continue making progress by crippling the other team.
  • Depending on the moveset, Arceus-Fairy can't respond to foes that resist Judgment such as Primal Groudon, Ho-Oh, and Necrozma-DM; therefore, it appreciates Pokemon that can answer them, which include Giratina-O, Primal Kyogre, and Marshadow.
  • Arceus-Fairy's bulk can be lacking on one side depending on its EV spread. Physically defensive variants can struggle against Palkia-O, Eternatus, and Arceus formes with Calm Mind, so it appreciates checks to them to complement its own defensive attributes like Ho-Oh, Necrozma-DM, and Primal Groudon. Meanwhile, specially defensive variants can have notable difficulties checking physical sweepers, which include Primal Groudon, Mega Salamence and Arceus, so Pokemon that can switch into them such as Giratina-O and Necrozma-DM are appreciated.

movesets.name: Calm Mind
movesets.description:
• Calm Mind Arceus-Fairy is an excellent bulky setup sweeper and wincon due to its excellent stats across the board, Fairy typing, and extensive coverage. Due to these qualities, it fits on a multitude of playstyles such as hyper offense, bulky offense, and balance.
  • Will-O-Wisp allows Arceus-Fairy to easily set up on Arceus, physical Arceus-Ground, and Mega Salamence lacking Facade. Power Gem is an option to hit Ho-Oh for meaningful damage. Taunt can be used to prevent Giratina-O, Primal Groudon, and Ho-Oh from crippling Arceus-Fairy with status such as Toxic or Thunder Wave and phazing it with Roar or Whirlwind. In addition, Taunt blocks Glare from Zygarde. Earth Power allows Arceus-Fairy to hit Primal Groudon, Eternatus, and Steel-types like Zacian-C and Necrozma-DM.
  • The given EV spread invests enough Speed for Arceus-Fairy to outspeed Primal Kyogre and Primal Groudon. The rest is invested into Defense and HP, giving Arceus-Fairy a high chance to survive a +2 Precipice Blades from Double Dance Primal Groudon while also avoiding an OHKO from Deoxys-A’s Psycho Boost after Stealth Rock and a 2HKO from Marshadow’s Poltergeist. The alternative EV spread with a Timid nature allows Arceus-Fairy to outspeed Modest Palkia-O and avoid a 2HKO from Choice Band Marshadow’s Spectral Thief after Stealth Rock.
  • Tera Dark provides Arceus-Fairy with a Psychic immunity, helping its team against powerful attacks such as Light That Burns the Sky from Ultra Necrozma, Psycho Boost from Deoxys-A, and Psystrike from Mega Mewtwo Y.
  • Tera Poison provides Arceus-Fairy a valuable immunity to Toxic and Toxic Spikes, allowing it to serve as the team’s Toxic Spikes absorber and check to opposing Arceus-Fairy and Eternatus.
  • Tera Ground ensures that Earth Power 2HKOes defensive Primal Groudon at +0 and gives it a chance to 2HKO defensive Necrozma-DM at +1.
  • On hyper offense, Arceus-Fairy is an excellent late-game wincon against a weakened team when checks such as Ho-Oh and Eternatus have been removed. On bulky offense and balance, Arceus-Fairy serves as an excellent check to Marshadow, Yveltal, and unboosted Mega Salamence throughout the game. It should not be afraid to switch into attacks from the aforementioned Pokemon, as any damage can be healed off with Recover. Arceus-Fairy must be wary of Toxic from Yveltal, Ho-Oh, and Giratina-O, which can heavily undermine its ability to sweep.
  • Arceus-Fairy’s sweeping ability is often hampered due to it being outsped by common threats such as Eternatus, Zacian-C, and Deoxys-A. For hyper offense, Sticky Web support from Shuckle flips these matchups and allows Arceus-Fairy to beat these checks. For bulky offense and balance, Thunder Wave support from Necrozma-DM eliminates this problem. Arceus-Fairy also appreciates duel screens support from Deoxys-S or Grimmsnarl, as this eases setup.
  • Regardless of what is chosen in the fourth moveslot, Arceus-Fairy will always suffer from a lack of coverage, as having Power Gem means it struggles against Primal Groudon, and having Earth Power means it cannot break past Ho-Oh. Teammates that can cover these vulnerabilities such as Primal Kyogre and Ultra Necrozma are helpful. Gothitelle is also a good teammate, as it effectively traps and removes walls such as Tera Steel Giratina-O, Ferrothorn, and Ho-Oh.

movesets.name: Calm Mind + Refresh
movesets.description:
• Compressing the roles of a stallbreaker, wall, and sweeper, Arceus-Fairy uses its lack of common weaknesses, well-rounded stats, and high longevity to act as a usable win condition against bulky team structures for balance teams.
  • Refresh ensures that Arceus-Fairy can't be hindered long-term by moves such as Toxic from Ho-Oh and Primal Groudon, easing the act of applying pressure on the opposing team and allowing more aggressive play compared to Taunt by not requiring it to safely switch into and outspeed a foe to avoid being inflicted with a status condition.
  • The first EV spread with a Bold nature outspeeds base 90 Speed foes such as Primal Groudon and Primal Kyogre, with the rest invested into physical bulk to have high odds at avoiding a 2HKO from Double Dance Primal Groudon's Precipice Blades; it additionally avoids a 2HKO from Choice Band Marshadow's Poltergeist as well as an OHKO from Life Orb Deoxys-A's Psycho Boost after Stealth Rock. The second EV spread with a Timid nature outspeeds neutral-natured base 120 Speed foes including Palkia-O and Mega Salamence and avoids a 2HKO from Choice Band Marshadow's Spectral Thief after Stealth Rock.
  • Tera Dark allows Arceus-Fairy to beat Psychic-types such as Ultra Necrozma and Mega Mewtwo Y one-on-one and become immune to status moves from the niche Grimmsnarl, all while retaining a Dark resistance to still handle foes such as Yveltal and Chien-Pao.
  • Arceus-Fairy should be used primarily as a wall early- to mid-game, as the need to use Calm Mind several times to break past Fairy-resistant foes makes it setup fodder for foes such as Double Dance Primal Groudon, Ho-Oh, and Zacian-C.
  • Arceus-Fairy can often brute force past bulky foes such as Terastallized Coil Zygarde, Primal Kyogre, and defensive Primal Groudon thanks to its high longevity, but it should be careful to preserve its Judgment and Recover PP.
  • While Arceus-Fairy acts as a good status absorber for its team thanks to Refresh, a turn is required to use it, which can often lead to scenarios where the opponent exploits this detail to safely bring in an offensive check against Arceus-Fairy. Therefore, it sometimes may be desirable to not immediately use Refresh after being subject to a status condition.
  • As Arceus-Fairy can struggle with Fairy-resistant foes such as opposing Primal Groudon, Ho-Oh, and Necrozma-DM, often limiting its potential against bulky team structures. Partners such as Zygarde and Primal Groudon can apply offensive pressure against these foes, and Gothitelle can trap and remove Ho-Oh and Necrozma-DM.
  • Pokemon such as Ferrothorn, Giratina-O, and Primal Kyogre handle Taunt users that can heavily limit Arceus-Fairy such as opposing Arceus-Water and Arceus-Ground. Ferrothorn, in particular,also supports Arceus-Fairy by discouraging switches with the entry hazards it sets, easing Arceus-Fairy's wallbreaking.
